4.2 Provider
The Synchronized Time-Base Manager itself does not provide any facility (e.g. protocols) for establishing a synchronized time among multiple nodes. Thus, the service requires other modules within the AUTOSAR BSW stack, which can provide this functionality. The FlexRay Interface and the TTCAN Interface are examples of modules which provide the definition of a synchronized time-base. Calling the provider (arrow “1” in Figure 1) or getting called by the provider (arrow “2” in Figure 1) are the possible ways how to communicate with the provider.
